name: node-update-preserves-edges
body: `apg node update <layer> <type> <name> [--body B] [--property k=v]*` must exist and be edge-preserving: read the existing NodeFile, mutate only the allowed fields (body, properties), keep every existing out-edge and in-edge, then write. The node's `layer`/`type`/`name` are its immutable identity — name is never updatable. Refuse if the node is absent. This is the capability whose absence (SPEC §1 root cause) makes re-add the only correction path. Acceptance: after `node update`, the node's body/properties changed and the count and content of its out/in edges are identical to before.
